dct_description_sm: See also Upper Similkameen Band Vermilion Forks 1 Reserve c.1890s_2023 https://doi.org/10.5683/SP3/ISMHAN

Georeferenced map of Upper Similkameen Band One Mile 6 Reserve, near McCaffrey Lake, clipped from the original Plan No. 1 of the Upper Similkameen Indian Reserves (https://doi.org/10.58066/wbga-x214). Land cover and features include trail from Nicola and Princeton, Graveyard Creek [Allison Creek], a fishery, and the types of land, soil, and timber.
